message: The main dashboard takes 30+ seconds to load and it's blocking our reporting workflow.
Thanks for reaching out—checking system performance now and looping in engineering.
Appreciate the quick reply, but this has been happening all morning. Any ETA?
We found a slow background job and deployed a fix. You should see faster load times over the next hour.
Dashboard is much faster now. Thanks for getting this sorted.
Our backend is suddenly getting 401 errors from your API. Nothing changed on our side.
We’ve reset your API key and corrected an issue on our end. Please try again.
Calls are going through again. Please let us know if this was a one-off or something we should watch for.
This was due to a faulty key rotation. It’s fully rolled back and monitored now.
Got it. Thanks for the transparency.
It would help our ops team a lot if your system auto-selected carriers based on our history.
Great suggestion—adding this to our feature backlog and sharing with product.
Thanks for considering it. Not urgent, but would be very useful.
Quick update: the request is in review but not scheduled yet. We’ll reach out if it’s prioritized.
Some stores aren't syncing inventory and local managers are escalating internally.
Sorry for the disruption—can you share which locations are affected so we can dig in?
Brookline and Lakeside for sure, possibly Hillcrest as well.
We found a stuck sync worker and restarted it. You should see data catching up shortly.
Numbers are still off this morning. This is causing some serious headaches.
We’ve pushed a patch to fix the underlying bug. The next sync should correct the inventory.
Looks accurate now. Thanks, but this caused a lot of noise on our side—please keep an eye on it.
Revenue totals in the weekly report seem wrong again and accounting is flagging it.
Thanks for flagging—can you confirm which report and date range?
"Weekly Sales Overview" for Jan 1–7.
We’ve identified a failed aggregation job and are re-running it now.
The report totals have been recalculated and updated. Let us know if anything still looks off.
New users can access admin settings—this is a serious security issue for us.
We’re treating this as high priority and have escalated to engineering.
We’ve temporarily restricted admin access while we implement a permanent fix.
Thanks for the quick reaction. Please confirm once the permanent fix is in place.
The permanent fix has been deployed and verified. Only designated admins can access those settings now.
Permissions look correct now. We'll keep monitoring, but this addresses our main concern.
Could you send last year’s contract? Our legal team can’t locate it.
Sharing a secure download link to the signed contract now.
Got it, thanks for the quick turnaround.
Our tracking page isn’t updating and our customers are complaining about missing status updates.
We’re investigating—early signs point to a delay in the sync job.
We’ve had to field several angry calls already. Please give us a realistic ETA.
Queue backlog has been cleared and updates are flowing again. There may still be a slight delay for older shipments.
Not perfect, but good enough for now. Please work on making this more resilient.
